title: am / is / are
lesson:
I → am (I'm)
he / she / it → is (he's, she's, it's)
we / you / they → are (we're, you're, they're)

• I am a student.
(Men talabaman.)
• She is at home.
(U uyda.)
• They are my friends.
(Ular mening do'stlarim.)

Negative (inkor):
I'm not · he/she/it isn't · we/you/they aren't

• I'm not hungry.
(Men och emasman.)
• It isn't cold today.
(Bugun sovuq emas.)
• We aren't late.
(Biz kechikmadik / kech emasmiz.)

q.q: My sister and I ___ good swimmers.
Tom ___ a teacher. He's a doctor. (negative)

q.uz: Men ochman. Keling, biror narsa yeymiz.

q.q: My parents ___ at work now. They're at home. (negative)
q.uz: Ota-onam hozir ishda emas. Ular uyda.

q.q: Write the short form: she is → ___

intro:
am / is / are — bu "bo'lmoq" fe'li (inglizcha to be). O'zbek tilida biz "Men talabaman", "U uyda" deymiz va bu gaplarda alohida fe'l yo'q. Ingliz tilida esa har bir gapda fe'l bo'lishi shart, shuning uchun bo'sh joyga am, is yoki are qo'yamiz.

Uni kim ekanimizni, qayerda ekanimizni, necha yoshda ekanimizni, qanday holatda ekanimizni aytish uchun ishlatamiz: I am a student. She is at home. We are tired.
explain:
1. Shakli

EgaTo'liqQisqaInkor
IamI'mI'm not
he / she / itishe's, she's, it'sisn't
we / you / theyarewe're, you're, they'rearen't

2. Nima uchun kerak?

Ingliz tilida har bir gapda fe'l bo'lishi shart. O'zbekchada "Men o'qituvchiman" deymiz va fe'l kerak emas. Inglizchada esa bo'sh joyga am / is / are qo'yiladi. Bu "bo'lmoq" fe'li (to be).

Qachon ishlatiladi:
• Kim ekanini aytish: I am a teacher. (Men o'qituvchiman.)
• Qayerdan ekani: She is from Samarkand. (U Samarqanddan.)
• Qayerda ekani: They are at school. (Ular maktabda.)
• Yoshi: I am 20 years old. (Men 20 yoshdaman.) — "I have 20" emas!
• Holat, his-tuyg'u: We are tired. (Biz charchadik.)
• Narsaning qanaqaligi: The film is interesting. (Film qiziqarli.)

3. Qaysi birini tanlash kerak?

Egaga qarang:
• Bitta odam yoki narsa (Ali, my mother, the car) → is
• Ikki va undan ko'p (Ali and Vali, my parents, the cars) → are
• you bilan doim are, hatto bitta odamga gapirsangiz ham.

4. Inkor

not fe'ldan keyin keladi: I am not · she is not (isn't) · they are not (aren't).
⚠️ "I amn't" deb bo'lmaydi, faqat I'm not.
tip: O'zbek tilida "men talabaman" deymiz — fe'l kerak emas. Ingliz tilida esa gapda albatta fe'l bo'lishi shart, shuning uchun am / is / are qo'shiladi: I am a student.
ex: The shops aren't open on Sunday.
mi: he / she / it bilan doim is.
agree — fe'l, unga am kerak emas.

title: am / is / are (questions)
lesson:
Savolda am / is / are gap boshiga chiqadi:

I am → Am I …?
he/she/it is → Is he/she/it …?
we/you/they are → Are we/you/they …?

• Are you a student?
(Siz talabamisiz?)
• Is it cold outside?
(Tashqarida sovuqmi?)
• Where is my phone?
(Telefonim qayerda?)

Short answers (qisqa javoblar):
Yes, I am. · No, I'm not.
Yes, it is. · No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. · No, they aren't.

• Are you tired? — Yes, I am.
(Charchadingizmi? — Ha.)

q.w: Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. (I'm emas!)

q.q: Is it cold today? — No, it ___.
q.w: Inkor qisqa javob: No, it isn't.

intro:
Bu mavzuda am / is / are bilan savol berishni o'rganamiz. O'zbek tilida savol yasash uchun so'z oxiriga "-mi" qo'shamiz: "Siz talabamisiz?" Ingliz tilida esa so'zlarning o'rni almashadi: am / is / are gapning boshiga chiqadi.

You are a student. → Are you a student?
Javob berishda qisqa javoblar ishlatiladi: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

1. Shakli

Darak gapSavol

2. Savol so'zlari bilan

Savol so'zi + am/is/are + ega:
• Where is your phone? (Telefoningiz qayerda?)
• How old are you? (Necha yoshdasiz?)
• What colour is it? (U qanday rangda?)
• Why are you late? (Nega kechikdingiz?)
• Who is that man? (Anavi odam kim?)

3. Qisqa javoblar

SavolHaYo'q
Are you…?Yes, I am.No, I'm not.

⚠️ Ijobiy qisqa javobda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi: Yes, I am. ("Yes, I'm" xato)
tip: O'zbekchada savolni "-mi" qo'shimchasi bilan yasaymiz: "Siz talabamisiz?". Inglizchada esa am / is / are gap boshiga chiqadi: You are → Are you …?
ex: Is it far from here? — No, it isn't.
Are they your friends? — Yes, they are.

title: I am doing (present continuous)
lesson:
am / is / are + verb-ing — hozir, ayni shu paytda bo'layotgan ish.

I am working.
(Men ishlayapman.)
She is reading a book.
(U kitob o'qiyapti.)
They are playing football.
(Ular futbol o'ynashyapti.)

Negative (inkor):
I'm not working · she isn't reading · they aren't playing

Spelling (yozilishi):
come → coming (e tushadi)
run → running, sit → sitting (undosh ikkilanadi)

• Look! It's raining.
(Qarang! Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
• Please be quiet. I'm studying.
(Iltimos, jim bo'ling. Men o'qiyapman.)

q.q: I ___ TV. You can turn it off. (not / watch)
q.uz: Men televizor ko'rmayapman. O'chirib qo'yishingiz mumkin.
Sara qayerda? — U dush qabul qilyapti.

q.q: The children ___ in the park now. (play)

q.w: "Listen!" — hozir eshitilyapti; somebody = birlik → is singing.

intro:
Present continuous — hozirgi davomli zamon. Biz uni ayni gapirayotgan paytimizda bo'layotgan ish-harakat uchun ishlatamiz. O'zbek tilida bunga "-yap" qo'shimchasi to'g'ri keladi: o'qiyapman, yozyapti, kutyapmiz.

Yasalishi: am / is / are + fe'l + ing.
I am reading. (Men o'qiyapman.) — hozir, shu daqiqada.
explain:
1. Shakli

am / is / are + fe'l-ing
Ega+−
Iam workingam not working
he / she / itis workingisn't working
we / you / theyare workingaren't working

2. Qachon ishlatiladi?

Hozir, aynan shu paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun:
• Please be quiet. I'm studying. (Iltimos, jim bo'ling. O'qiyapman.)
• Look! It's snowing. (Qarang! Qor yog'yapti.)

Shu kunlarda davom etayotgan ish uchun (aynan shu daqiqada bo'lmasa ham):
• I'm reading a good book these days. (Shu kunlarda yaxshi kitob o'qiyapman.)
• She's learning English this year. (U bu yil ingliz tilini o'rganyapti.)

Belgi so'zlar: now, at the moment, today, this week, Look!, Listen!

3. -ing qo'shishning qoidalari

• Ko'pincha shunchaki qo'shiladi: work → working, read → reading
• Oxiri -e bo'lsa, e tushadi: come → coming, write → writing
• Bitta unli + bitta undosh bilan tugasa, undosh ikkilanadi: sit → sitting, run → running, swim → swimming
• -ie → -ying: lie → lying, die → dying

4. Eng ko'p xato

Ikki qism ham shart: am/is/are + -ing. "I working" ham, "I am work" ham xato.
tip: O'zbekchadagi "-yap" (o'qiyapman, ishlayapti) qo'shimchasi inglizchada am/is/are + -ing ga to'g'ri keladi. Ikkalasini ham ishlatish shart: is + reading.

title: are you doing? (present continuous questions)
lesson:
am / is / are + subject + verb-ing?

• Are you working today?
(Bugun ishlayapsizmi?)
• Is it raining?
(Yomg'ir yog'yaptimi?)
• What are you doing?
(Nima qilyapsiz?)
• Why is she crying?
(U nega yig'layapti?)

Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. · Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

q.w: she → is: Why is she crying?

q.q: Where are they going? — They ___ to the cinema. (go)
Are you listening to me? — Yes, I ___.
Is Tom working today? — No, he ___.

intro:
Bu mavzuda present continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon) bilan savol berishni o'rganamiz. Ya'ni "Hozir nima qilyapsiz?", "U qayerga ketyapti?" kabi savollarni.

Qoida 2-unitdagidek: am / is / are gapning boshiga chiqadi, fe'l esa -ing bilan qoladi.
You are working. → Are you working? (Ishlayapsizmi?)
explain:
1. Savol shakli

am / is / are egadan oldinga chiqadi, fe'l -ing shaklida qoladi:
Darak gapSavol
You are working.Are you working?
She is crying.Is she crying?
They are going.Are they going?

2. Savol so'zlari bilan

Savol so'zi + am/is/are + ega + fe'l-ing?
• What are you doing? (Nima qilyapsiz?)
• Where is she going? (U qayerga ketyapti?)
• Why are you laughing? (Nega kulyapsiz?)
• Who is he talking to? (U kim bilan gaplashyapti?)

3. Qisqa javoblar

Are you working? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Is it raining? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
⚠️ Qisqa javobda -ing fe'l takrorlanmaydi: "Yes, I am working" ham to'g'ri, lekin odatda faqat "Yes, I am" deyiladi.
tip: O'zbekchada "Nima qilyapsiz?" deymiz. Inglizchada so'zlar tartibi: What + are + you + doing? "What you are doing?" deb bo'lmaydi.
ex: Are you enjoying the party? — Yes, I am.

title: I do / work / like (present simple)
lesson:
Odatiy, doimiy ishlar uchun: I/you/we/they work — he/she/it works

• I work in an office.
(Men ofisda ishlayman.)
• She lives in Tashkent.
(U Toshkentda yashaydi.)
• The sun rises in the east.
(Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi.)

Spelling: watch → watches, go → goes, study → studies, have → has
intro:
Present simple — hozirgi oddiy zamon. Biz uni doim, har kuni, odatda bo'ladigan ishlar uchun, shuningdek doimiy holat va umumiy haqiqatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Ayni paytda bo'layotgan ish uchun emas!

O'zbek tilida bunga "-adi / -aman" qo'shimchasi to'g'ri keladi: ishlayman, yashaydi, ichadi.
I work every day. (Men har kuni ishlayman.)
⚠️ Eng muhim qoida: he / she / it bilan fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: She works.
explain:
1. Shakli

EgaFe'l
I / you / we / theywork, live, like
he / she / itworks, lives, likes
⚠️ he / she / it (bitta odam yoki narsa) bo'lsa, fe'lga -s qo'shiladi. Eng ko'p unutiladigan qoida shu!

2. Qachon ishlatiladi?

• Odat, takrorlanadigan ish: I get up at 7 every day. (Har kuni 7 da turaman.)
• Doimiy holat: She lives in Bukhara. (U Buxoroda yashaydi.)
• Umumiy haqiqat: The sun rises in the east. (Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi.)
• Yoqtirish, bilish: I like tea. He knows the answer.

Belgi so'zlar: every day, usually, always, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays

3. -s qo'shishning qoidalari

• Odatda: work → works, play → plays
• -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa → -es: watch → watches, go → goes, do → does, fix → fixes
• Undosh + -y → -ies: study → studies, fly → flies (lekin play → plays)
• have → has
tip: O'zbekchada "-adi" qo'shimchasi (ishlaydi, yashaydi) ko'pincha present simple'ga to'g'ri keladi. Hozir, ayni paytda bo'layotgan "-yapti" bilan adashtirmang: u Unit 3 ning mavzusi.
ex: Men har kuni ertalab choy ichaman.
My father works in a hospital.
We usually go to the park on Sundays.
Biz odatda yakshanba kunlari bog'ga boramiz.

title: I don't ... (present simple negative)
lesson:
I/you/we/they don't (do not) + verb
he/she/it doesn't (does not) + verb

• I don't like coffee.
(Men qahvani yoqtirmayman.)
• She doesn't eat meat.
(U go'sht yemaydi.)

⚠️ doesn't dan keyin fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: she doesn't play (not plays)

q.q: Make negative: She plays tennis. → She ___ tennis.
q.w: plays → doesn't play (-s doesn't ga o'tdi).

q.q: Make negative: I know the answer. → I ___ the answer.

intro:
Bu mavzuda present simple (hozirgi oddiy zamon) da inkor gap tuzishni o'rganamiz, ya'ni "qilmayman", "bilmaydi", "yoqtirmaymiz" kabi gaplarni.

O'zbek tilida inkor uchun fe'lga "-ma" qo'shamiz: yoqtirmayman. Ingliz tilida esa fe'ldan oldin don't yoki doesn't qo'yiladi:
I don't like coffee. (Men qahvani yoqtirmayman.)
She doesn't like coffee. (U qahvani yoqtirmaydi.)
explain:
1. Shakli

EgaInkor
I / you / we / theydon't (do not) + fe'l
he / she / itdoesn't (does not) + fe'l

2. Eng muhim qoida

doesn't dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi, ya'ni -s qo'shilmaydi:
• She plays → She doesn't play (not doesn't plays)
• He has → He doesn't have (not doesn't has)
Chunki -s endi does ga o'tib ketdi: doesn't.

3. Misollar

• I don't like coffee. (Men qahvani yoqtirmayman.)
• He doesn't eat meat. (U go'sht yemaydi.)
• We don't work on Sundays. (Biz yakshanba kunlari ishlamaymiz.)
• It doesn't cost much. (U qimmat turmaydi.)

4. am/is/are bilan adashtirmang

• She isn't a teacher. (be fe'li) (U o'qituvchi emas.)
• She doesn't teach. (oddiy fe'l) (U dars bermaydi.)
"I'm not like" xato, to'g'risi I don't like.
tip: O'zbekchada inkor fe'lning o'ziga qo'shiladi: "yoqtir-ma-yman". Inglizchada esa fe'ldan oldin alohida so'z keladi: don't / doesn't.
ex: He doesn't live here any more.
mi: like — oddiy fe'l, unga don't kerak.

title: Do you ...? (present simple questions)
lesson:
Do I/you/we/they + verb? · Does he/she/it + verb?

• Do you play tennis?
(Tennis o'ynaysizmi?)
• Where does she live?
(U qayerda yashaydi?)
• What does this word mean?
(Bu so'z nimani anglatadi?)

Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. · Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

q.q: Do you like football? — Yes, I ___.
Does he work here? — No, he ___.
How often ___ you go to the cinema?

intro:
Bu mavzuda present simple (hozirgi oddiy zamon) da savol berishni o'rganamiz, ya'ni odat va doimiy ishlar haqida: "Qayerda yashaysiz?", "Kofe ichasizmi?"

Savol uchun gap boshiga Do yoki Does qo'yiladi. Bu so'zlar o'zbekchaga tarjima qilinmaydi, ular faqat "bu savol" degan belgi:
Do you speak English? (Inglizcha gapirasizmi?)
Does she work here? (U shu yerda ishlaydimi?)
explain:
1. Shakli

SavolEgaFe'l
DoI / you / we / theywork? like?
Doeshe / she / itwork? like?
⚠️ Does bilan ham fe'l asosiy shaklda: Does she live…? (not lives)

2. Savol so'zlari bilan

Savol so'zi + do/does + ega + fe'l?
• Where do you live? (Qayerda yashaysiz?)
• What does he do? (U nima ish qiladi?)
• How often do you go to the gym? (Sport zaliga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz?)
• What time does the shop open? (Do'kon soat nechada ochiladi?)

3. Qisqa javoblar

Do you like it? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Does she work? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

4. Do va Are ni adashtirmang

• Are you a student? — be fe'li (kim/qanaqa ekan)

"Are you like football?" xato, to'g'risi Do you like football?

ex: How often do you call your parents?
Do you like apples? — Yes, I do.
Does he smoke? — No, he doesn't.

title: I am doing and I do
lesson:
I am doing — hozir, ayni paytda:
• Look! It's raining.
(Qarang! Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)

I do — odatda, doimo, har kuni:
• It rains a lot in autumn.
(Kuzda yomg'ir ko'p yog'adi.)

• What are you doing? — I'm reading.
(Nima qilyapsiz? — O'qiyapman.)
• What do you do? — I'm a doctor.
(Kasbingiz nima? — Shifokorman.)

q.uz: Men har kuni ishga piyoda boraman.

q.q: She usually ___ coffee in the morning. (drink)

q.w: "I'm a teacher" — kasb → What do you do?

intro:
Bu mavzuda ikki zamonni — present continuous (I am doing) va present simple (I do) — solishtiramiz. Ikkalasi ham "hozirgi zamon", lekin ma'nosi farq qiladi:

• I am doing — hozir, ayni paytda: I'm drinking tea. (Hozir choy ichyapman.)
• I do — odatda, har doim: I drink tea every morning. (Har kuni ertalab choy ichaman.)

O'zbek tilida ham shunday farq bor: "ichyapman" va "ichaman".
explain:
1. Ikki zamonni solishtiring

Present continuous
(am/is/are + -ing)		Present simple
(work / works)
Hozir, ayni paytdaOdatda, doim, har kuni
VaqtinchalikDoimiy
now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!every day, usually, always, often, never

2. Misollar bilan

• It is raining now. (Hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
• It rains a lot in spring. (Bahorda yomg'ir ko'p yog'adi.)

• I'm wearing a jacket today. (Bugun kurtka kiyib olganman.)
• I usually wear a shirt. (Odatda ko'ylak kiyaman.)

3. Muhim farq

• What are you doing? = Hozir nima qilyapsiz?
• What do you do? = Kasbingiz nima? (— I'm a teacher.)

4. -ing shaklida deyarli ishlatilmaydigan fe'llar

like, love, hate, want, need, know, understand, remember, believe, mean
• I want some water. (not I'm wanting)
• Do you understand? (not Are you understanding?)
tip: O'zbekchada ham shu farq bor: "o'qiyapman" (hozir) va "o'qiyman" (odatda). "-yap" bo'lsa am/is/are + -ing, oddiy "-adi" bo'lsa present simple ishlatiladi.
ex: I'm cooking now. I cook every evening.
Hozir ovqat pishiryapman. Har kech ovqat pishiraman.
Today she is taking a taxi.
What do you do? — I'm a driver.
Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
mi: I am go to school every day.
I go to school every day.
What do you do? / What are you doing?

title: I have ... / I've got ...
lesson:
Ikkalasi ham "bor" ma'nosini beradi:
• I have a car. = I've got a car.
(Mening mashinam bor.)
• She has blue eyes. = She's got blue eyes.
(Uning ko'zlari ko'k.)

Negative: I don't have / I haven't got · she doesn't have / she hasn't got
Questions: Do you have …? / Have you got …?

q.q: Have you got a car? — No, I ___.
q.w: Have you got…? → No, I haven't.

q.q: Do you have a pen? — Yes, I ___.
q.w: Do you have…? → Yes, I do.

intro:
Bu mavzuda "bor" degan ma'noni bildirishni o'rganamiz: "mening mashinam bor", "uning ikki akasi bor".

Ingliz tilida buning ikki usuli bor va ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noni beradi:
• I have a car.
• I've got a car.
(Mening mashinam bor.)

Diqqat: o'zbekchada "mening mashinam" deymiz, inglizchada esa "I have" (men egaman) deyiladi.
explain:
1. Ikki xil shakl, bir xil ma'no

havehave got
I/you/we/theyI have a car.I've got a car.
he/she/itShe has a car.She's got a car.
InkorI don't have
she doesn't have		I haven't got
she hasn't got
SavolDo you have…?
Does she have…?		Have you got…?
Has she got…?
Ikkalasi ham "bor" (egalik) ma'nosini beradi. have got ko'proq og'zaki nutqda, ayniqsa Britaniyada ishlatiladi.

2. Qachon ishlatiladi?

• Narsa: I have a new phone. (Yangi telefonim bor.)
• Oila: She has two brothers. (Uning ikki akasi bor.)
• Tashqi ko'rinish: He has blue eyes. (Uning ko'zlari ko'k.)
• Kasallik: I have a headache. (Boshim og'riyapti.)

3. Aralashtirmang!

• Do you have…? ✅ · Have you got…? ✅
• "Do you have got…?" ❌ · "Have you a car?" ❌ (eskirgan)
• O'tgan zamonda faqat had: I had a bike. · Did you have…?
tip: O'zbekchada "mening mashinam bor" deymiz. Inglizchada esa ega + have: I have a car. "There is my car" yoki "My car is" deb tarjima qilmang.
ex: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Has your flat got a balcony?
mi: Do you have got a pen?
Do you have a pen? / Have you got a pen?

title: was / were
lesson:
am/is → was · are → were
I/he/she/it was · we/you/they were

• I was tired yesterday.
(Kecha charchagan edim.)
• They were at home.
(Ular uyda edi.)

Negative: wasn't / weren't · Questions: Was he …? Were you …?

q.q: The film ___ very good. It was boring. (negative)
q.uz: Film unchalik yaxshi emas edi. Zerikarli edi.

q.q: They ___ at school yesterday. They were ill. (negative)
q.uz: Ular kecha maktabda emas edi. Kasal edi.

q.q: Were you at work? — Yes, I ___.

intro:
was / were — bu am / is / are ning o'tgan zamondagi shakli. Biz uni o'tmishda kim, qayerda, qanday holatda bo'lganini aytish uchun ishlatamiz.

O'zbek tilida bunga ko'pincha "edi" so'zi to'g'ri keladi:
I was tired. (Charchagan edim.)
They were at home. (Ular uyda edi.)

am, is → was · are → were
explain:
1. Shakli

HozirO'tgan zamon
I amI was
he / she / it ishe / she / it was
we / you / they arewe / you / they were
Inkor: wasn't (was not), weren't (were not)
Savol: Was he…? Were you…?

2. Qachon ishlatiladi?

am/is/are ning o'tgan zamoni, ya'ni "edi" ma'nosida:
• I was tired yesterday. (Kecha charchagan edim.)
• They were at home last night. (Ular kecha kechqurun uyda edi.)
• The weather was nice. (Havo yaxshi edi.)
• Where were you? (Qayerda edingiz?)
• I was born in 2005. (Men 2005 yilda tug'ilganman.) — tug'ilish doim was/were bilan aytiladi!

Belgi so'zlar: yesterday, last week, last year, ago, in 2010

3. Qisqa javoblar

Were you there? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Was it good? — Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
tip: O'zbekchadagi "edi" (charchagan edim, uyda edi) ko'pincha was / were ga to'g'ri keladi. Tanlash oson: I va bittasi bo'lsa was, ko'pchilik va you bo'lsa were.
ex: It was very cold last winter.
Why were you late? — The bus was late.

title: worked / got / went (past simple)
lesson:
Regular: work → worked, live → lived, stop → stopped, study → studied
Irregular: go → went, see → saw, buy → bought, get → got, write → wrote

• I watched TV last night.
(Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdim.)
• She went to London last year.
(U o'tgan yili Londonga bordi.)

q.q: He ___ his car two years ago. (buy)
q.uz: U mashinasini ikki yil oldin sotib oldi.

q.q: They ___ in Paris for three years. (live)
I ___ up at 7 o'clock this morning.
The lesson ___ at 9 and finished at 10. (start)
q.uz: Dars soat 9 da boshlanib, 10 da tugadi.

intro:
Past simple — o'tgan oddiy zamon. Biz uni o'tmishda bo'lib, tugagan ish-harakat uchun ishlatamiz: kecha, o'tgan hafta, 2 yil oldin. O'zbek tilida bunga "-di" qo'shimchasi to'g'ri keladi: ko'rdim, bordi, yozdik.

I watched TV yesterday. (Kecha televizor ko'rdim.)
explain:
1. Shakli

Past simple'da fe'l barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: I worked, she worked, they worked. Hech qanday -s qo'shilmaydi.

2. To'g'ri fe'llar (regular): + ed

QoidaMisol
Odatda + edwork → worked, play → played
Oxiri -e → + dlive → lived, like → liked
Undosh + y → iedstudy → studied, try → tried
Qisqa so'z, unli + undosh → undosh ikkilanadistop → stopped, plan → planned

3. Noto'g'ri fe'llar (irregular)

Ularni yodlash kerak. Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari:
go → went · see → saw · come → came · get → got · buy → bought · make → made · have → had · do → did · eat → ate · write → wrote · take → took · give → gave · know → knew · think → thought · leave → left · meet → met

4. Qachon ishlatiladi?

O'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda bo'lgan ish uchun:
• I met Ali yesterday. (Kecha Ali bilan uchrashdim.)
• They moved to Tashkent in 2020. (Ular 2020 yilda Toshkentga ko'chishdi.)

Belgi so'zlar: yesterday, last week/month/year, ago, in 2015, when I was a child
tip: O'zbekchadagi "-di" (bordi, ko'rdi) ko'pincha past simple ga to'g'ri keladi. Inglizchada esa fe'l shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi: I went, he went, we went — hammasi bir xil.
ex: I watched a good film last night.
She went to Samarkand last week.
We bought a new car two years ago.
Ikki yil oldin yangi mashina sotib oldik.
They stopped the car and got out.
I wrote a letter to my friend.

title: I didn't ... Did you ...?
lesson:
didn't + verb (asosiy shakl) · Did you + verb?

• I didn't go out.
(Men tashqariga chiqmadim.)
• Did you see Tom?
(Tomni ko'rdingizmi?)

⚠️ did/didn't dan keyin: go (not went), see (not saw)
Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

q.w: didn't dan keyin asosiy shakl → know.

q.q: Did you enjoy the party? — Yes, I ___.
Did they win the game? — No, they ___.
What time ___ the film finish yesterday?
Make negative: He played football. → He ___ football.

intro:
Bu mavzuda past simple (o'tgan oddiy zamon) da inkor va savol gaplarni o'rganamiz: "bormadim", "ko'rdingizmi?"

Buning uchun yordamchi so'z did ishlatiladi. Muhim qoida: did o'tgan zamonni o'zi ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun asosiy fe'l oddiy shaklda qoladi:
I went → I didn't go. · She saw → Did she see?
explain:
1. Shakli

ShaklMisol
Inkordidn't + fe'lI didn't go out.
SavolDid + ega + fe'l?Did you go out?
Savol so'zi bilanWhere did + ega + fe'l?Where did you go?
did / didn't hamma shaxslar uchun bir xil: I didn't, she didn't, they didn't.

2. Eng muhim qoida

did dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi:
• I didn't go ✅ — I didn't went ❌
• Did you see? ✅ — Did you saw? ❌
O'tgan zamon belgisi faqat bitta joyda bo'ladi: did da.

3. Qisqa javoblar

Did you call him? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

4. was/were bilan adashtirmang

• Were you tired? — be fe'li (holat)
• Did you sleep? — oddiy fe'l (harakat)
"Did you tired?" xato, to'g'risi Were you tired?
tip: O'zbekchada inkor fe'lning ichida bo'ladi: bor-ma-dim. Inglizchada esa alohida didn't qo'yiladi, fe'l esa o'zgarmaydi: I didn't go.
ex: I didn't sleep well last night.
Did you see the match yesterday?
She didn't come to the lesson.
Where did you buy that jacket?
Did they win? — No, they didn't.

title: I was doing (past continuous)
lesson:
was / were + verb-ing — o'tmishda ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan ish.

• At 8 o'clock I was having dinner.
(Soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.)
• They were watching TV.
(Ular televizor ko'rayotgan edi.)

Negative: wasn't / weren't + -ing · Questions: Were you working?

q.uz: Kecha soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.
q.w: Kecha soat 8 da davom etayotgan ish; I → was having.

q.uz: Men kelganimda ular televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
Kecha soat 10 da nima qilayotgan edingiz?
q.w: you → were; savolda were oldinga chiqadi.

q.q: We ___ to music. We were talking. (not / listen)
q.uz: Biz musiqa tinglamayotgan edik. Gaplashayotgan edik.
U kechki 9 da kitob o'qiyotgan edi.

intro:
Past continuous — o'tgan davomli zamon. Biz uni o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun ishlatamiz. O'zbek tilida bunga "-yotgan edi" to'g'ri keladi: o'qiyotgan edim, ishlayotgan edi.

At 8 o'clock I was having dinner. (Soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.)
explain:
1. Shakli

was / were + fe'l-ing
Ega+−?
I / he / she / itwas workingwasn't workingWas he working?
we / you / theywere workingweren't workingWere you working?

2. Qachon ishlatiladi?

O'tmishdagi aniq bir paytda ish hali tugamagan, davom etayotgan bo'lsa:
• At 10 o'clock yesterday I was sleeping. (Kecha soat 10 da uxlayotgan edim.)
• This time last year we were living in Bukhara. (O'tgan yil shu paytda Buxoroda yashayotgan edik.)

Vaziyatni, fonni tasvirlash uchun:
• It was raining and people were running. (Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan, odamlar yugurayotgan edi.)

3. Past simple bilan farqi

• I was reading at 9. — soat 9 da o'qish davom etayotgan edi (jarayon)
• I read a book yesterday. — kitobni o'qidim, tugatdim (natija)
tip: O'zbekchadagi "-yotgan edi" (ketayotgan edi, yozayotgan edim) past continuous ga to'g'ri keladi. Inglizchada: was/were + -ing.
ex: I was watching TV at 9 o'clock.
What were you doing yesterday evening?
They weren't listening to the teacher.
She was cooking when I called.
Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.
We were waiting for the bus.

title: I was doing and I did
lesson:
was doing — davom etayotgan (uzun) ish
did — tugallangan (qisqa) ish

• I was having dinner when the phone rang.
(Telefon jiringlaganda kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.)
• When the phone rang, I answered it.
(Telefon jiringlaganda, men javob berdim.)

q.q: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
q.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.
q.w: Telefon jiringlaganda ovqat davom etayotgan edi → was having.

q.q: When the phone rang, I ___ it.
q.w: Telefon jiringladi, keyin javob berdim → answered.

q.q: Kate ___ her finger while she was cooking. (cut)
q.uz: Keyt ovqat pishirayotganda barmog'ini kesib oldi.

q.q: I saw Ali when I ___ to work. (walk)
q.w: Uzun, davom etayotgan ish → was walking.

q.q: We ___ in the park when it started to rain. (walk)
q.uz: Yomg'ir boshlanganda bog'da sayr qilayotgan edik.

q.q: While I ___ TV, I fell asleep.

q.uz: Men kelganimda ular kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edi.
q.w: Men kelganda ovqat davom etayotgan edi → were having.

q.q: Yesterday I ___ up at 7 and ___ breakfast.
q.uz: Kecha soat 7 da turib, nonushta qildim.

intro:
Bu mavzuda past continuous (was doing) va past simple (did) ni birga ishlatishni o'rganamiz.

Ko'pincha bitta gapda ikkalasi keladi: uzun, davom etayotgan ish — was doing, uni bo'lgan qisqa ish — did.
I was walking home when it started to rain. (Uyga ketayotganimda yomg'ir boshlandi.)
explain:
1. Ikki zamonni solishtiring

was/were + -ingPast simple
Uzun, davom etayotgan ish (fon)Qisqa, tugallangan ish
I was having dinner……when the phone rang.

2. Asosiy holatlar

a) Uzun ish + qisqa ish (when bilan):
• I was cooking when she arrived. (U kelganda ovqat pishirayotgan edim.)
b) while + davomli ish:
• While I was sleeping, someone called. (Uxlayotganimda kimdir qo'ng'iroq qildi.)
c) Ketma-ket ishlar — hammasi past simple:
• I got up, had breakfast and went to work. (Turdim, nonushta qildim va ishga ketdim.)

3. Ma'no farqi

• When she came, we were having dinner. — u kelganda ovqat allaqachon boshlangan edi.
• When she came, we had dinner. — u kelgandan keyin ovqatlandik.
tip: O'zbekchada: "Ovqat yeyayotganimda telefon jiringladi." — birinchisi "-yotgan" (was doing), ikkinchisi "-di" (did). Ingliz tilida ham xuddi shunday.
ex: I was reading when the lights went out.
She broke her leg while she was skiing.
When I arrived, they were watching a film.
Men kelganimda ular film ko'rayotgan edi.
When I arrived, they turned off the TV.
We were walking in the park when we met Ali.
Bog'da sayr qilayotganimizda Ali bilan uchrashdik.
He opened the door and went out.
U eshikni ochdi va chiqib ketdi.
mi: I watched TV when you called.
I was watching TV when you called.
While I cooked, I cut my finger.
While I was cooking, I cut my finger.
When the phone rang, I was answering it.
When the phone rang, I answered it.

title: I have done (present perfect 1)
lesson:
have / has + past participle (3-shakl) — o'tmishdagi ish, natijasi hozir muhim.

• I've lost my keys. (= I can't find them now)
(Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim — hozir topa olmayapman.)
• She has cut her hair.
(U sochini kaltalatibdi.)

Past participle: finish → finished, go → gone, write → written, eat → eaten, see → seen

q.q: I ___ my keys. I can't find them. (lose)
q.w: Natija hozir: kalitlar yo'q → have lost.

q.q: She ___ her hair. It looks nice. (cut)

q.uz: Tom bu yerda yo'q. U uyiga ketgan.

q.q: The bus ___ . We're still waiting. (not / arrive)

intro:
Present perfect — hozirgi tugallangan zamon. Biz uni o'tmishda bo'lgan, lekin natijasi hozir muhim bo'lgan ish uchun ishlatamiz. Ishning qachon bo'lgani aytilmaydi.

I have lost my keys. (Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim — hozir ular yo'q.)
Yasalishi: have / has + fe'lning 3-shakli.
explain:
1. Shakli

Ega+−?
I / you / we / theyhave ('ve) donehaven't doneHave you done?
he / she / ithas ('s) donehasn't doneHas she done?

2. Fe'lning 3-shakli (past participle)

To'g'ri fe'llarda past simple bilan bir xil: work → worked, finish → finished.
Noto'g'ri fe'llarda yodlash kerak:
go → gone · see → seen · do → done · eat → eaten · write → written · take → taken · break → broken · lose → lost · buy → bought · be → been

3. Qachon ishlatiladi?

• Natija hozir ko'rinib turibdi: She has cut her hair. (U sochini kaltalatibdi — hozir qisqa.)
• Yangilik aytish: I've found a new job! (Yangi ish topdim!)
• Hozirgacha bo'lmagan: The bus hasn't arrived. (Avtobus hali kelmadi.)

⚠️ Aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan (yesterday, last year, ago) present perfect ishlatilmaydi. Bu haqda Unit 20 da batafsil o'rganamiz.
tip: O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha "-ib qo'ydim", "-ibdi" to'g'ri keladi: yo'qotib qo'ydim, kelibdi, sindirib qo'yibdi. Ya'ni natijasi hozir ham sezilib turgan ish.
ex: She has gone to the shop.

title: I've just ... I've already ... I haven't ... yet
lesson:
just — hozirgina: I've just had lunch.
(Hozirgina tushlik qildim.)
already — allaqachon: I've already seen this film.
(Bu filmni allaqachon ko'rganman.)
yet — hali (inkor va savolda, gap oxirida):
• I haven't finished yet.
(Hali tugatmadim.)
• Have you finished yet?
(Tugatdingizmi?)

q.q: I've ___ had lunch, so I'm not hungry.
q.uz: Hozirgina tushlik qildim, shuning uchun och emasman.

q.q: Don't tell me the end! I haven't seen the film ___.
Is Tom here? — No, he's ___ gone. (a minute ago)
q.uz: Tom shu yerdami? — Yo'q, hozirgina ketdi.

q.q: Do you want to read this book? — No, I've ___ read it.
q.uz: Bu kitobni o'qishni xohlaysizmi? — Yo'q, allaqachon o'qiganman.

intro:
Bu mavzuda present perfect bilan ko'p ishlatiladigan uchta so'zni o'rganamiz:
• just — hozirgina: I've just eaten. (Hozirgina ovqatlandim.)
• already — allaqachon: I've already eaten. (Allaqachon ovqatlanib bo'ldim.)
• yet — hali (inkor va savolda): I haven't eaten yet. (Hali ovqatlanmadim.)
explain:
1. Joylashuvi

So'zQayerda turadiMisol
justhave/has va fe'l orasidaI've just arrived.
alreadyhave/has va fe'l orasidaShe's already left.
yetgapning oxiridaHave you finished yet?

2. Ma'nosi

just — juda yaqinda, bir necha daqiqa oldin.
already — kutilganidan oldinroq bo'ldi: "Bunga hojat yo'q, men allaqachon qildim".
yet — kutilyapti, lekin hali bo'lmadi (inkor) yoki "bo'ldimi?" (savol).

3. Misollar

• Don't call Ali. I've already told him. (Aliga qo'ng'iroq qilmang. Men allaqachon aytdim.)
• Is Lola here? — No, she's just gone. (Lola shu yerdami? — Yo'q, hozirgina ketdi.)
• The film hasn't started yet. (Film hali boshlanmadi.)
• Has the bus come yet? (Avtobus keldimi?)
tip: O'zbekchada: "hozirgina" = just, "allaqachon" = already, "hali …-madi" = not … yet. Faqat yet gap oxirida turishini eslab qoling.
ex: I haven't read the book yet.
Have you done your homework yet?
Don't buy bread. I've already bought some.

title: Have you ever ...?
lesson:
Hayotingizda biror marta qilganmisiz?

• Have you ever been to Japan?
(Hech Yaponiyada bo'lganmisiz?)
• I've never eaten sushi.
(Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman.)
• She has been to Paris three times.
(U Parijda uch marta bo'lgan.)

been = borib qaytgan · gone = ketgan, hali u yerda

q.q: I've ___ eaten sushi. I want to try it.
q.uz: Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman. Tatib ko'rmoqchiman.

q.q: She has ___ to Paris three times. (be)
Have you ever played golf? — Yes, I ___.
Have you ever lost your passport? — No, I ___.
This is the best film I've ___ seen.
q.uz: Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film.

q.q: Where's Anna? — She has ___ to the shop.
q.w: Do'konga ketgan, hali u yerda → gone.

intro:
Bu mavzuda hayotimizdagi tajriba haqida gapirishni o'rganamiz: "Hech Yaponiyada bo'lganmisiz?", "Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman."

Buning uchun ham present perfect ishlatiladi, ko'pincha ever (hech) va never (hech qachon) so'zlari bilan:
Have you ever been to London? — No, I've never been there.
explain:
1. Shakli

Misol
SavolHave you ever + 3-shakl?
Have you ever eaten sushi?
HaYes, I have. / I've eaten it twice.
Yo'qNo, I haven't. / I've never eaten it.

2. Qachon ishlatiladi?

Hayotimizda biror marta bo'lgan yoki bo'lmagan narsa haqida (qachonligi muhim emas):
• I've been to Istanbul three times. (Istanbulda uch marta bo'lganman.)
• She has never driven a car. (U hech qachon mashina haydamagan.)
• This is the best film I've ever seen. (Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film.)

3. been va gone farqi

• She has been to Paris. — borib, qaytib kelgan.
• She has gone to Paris. — ketgan, hozir o'sha yerda.

4. Aniq vaqt aytilsa — past simple

Have you ever been to Khiva? — Yes, I went there last year.
tip: O'zbekchadagi "-gan" (bo'lgan, ko'rgan, yemagan) tajriba ma'nosida present perfect ga to'g'ri keladi: "Ko'rganman" = I've seen.
ex: Have you ever been to Japan?
I've never seen snow in May.
She has visited Samarkand many times.
Have you ever met a famous person?
This is the most delicious plov I've ever eaten.
Bu men yegan eng mazali palov.
He's gone to Moscow. He'll be back next week.
U Moskvaga ketgan. Keyingi hafta qaytadi.
mi: Did you ever be in London?
Have you ever been to London?
I have never been there. / I have never gone there.
never o'zi inkor, not kerak emas.
I have been in Paris last year.
I was in Paris last year.

title: How long have you ...?
lesson:
O'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat:
have been / have known / have lived …
have been + -ing (davom etayotgan ish)

• How long have you lived here?
(Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaysiz?)
• I've known her for ten years.
(Uni o'n yildan beri taniyman.)
• It has been raining since morning.
(Ertalabdan beri yomg'ir yog'yapti.)

⚠️ I have known her for … (not I know her for …)

q.w: How long savoli → have you known.

q.uz: Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman.
q.w: Hozirgacha davom etmoqda → have lived / have been living.

q.uz: Biz turmush qurganimizga o'n yil bo'ldi.
q.w: Hozirgacha davom etgan holat → have been married.

q.q: I know Ali. I ___ him for a long time.
q.uz: Men Alini taniyman. Uni ancha vaqtdan beri bilaman.

q.q: They ___ waiting for an hour. (be — present perfect)

intro:
Bu mavzuda o'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat haqida gapirishni o'rganamiz: "Bu yerda 5 yildan beri yashayman", "Uni bolalikdan beri taniyman".

O'zbek tilida hozirgi zamon ("yashayman") ishlatiladi, ingliz tilida esa present perfect kerak:
I have lived here for 5 years. ("I live here for 5 years" xato!)
explain:
1. Shakli

TuriShaklMisol
Holathave/has + 3-shaklI've known her for years.
Davom etayotgan ishhave/has been + -ingIt has been raining since morning.

2. Savol

How long have you + 3-shakl / been -ing?
• How long have you lived here? (Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaysiz?)
• How long has she been learning English? (U qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapti?)

3. Eng ko'p xato

O'zbekchada "Men uni 10 yildan beri taniyman" (hozirgi zamon) deymiz, shuning uchun ko'pchilik "I know her for 10 years" deb yozadi. Bu xato!
✅ I have known her for 10 years.

4. -ing bilan ishlatilmaydigan fe'llar

know, like, love, want, have (egalik) bilan faqat oddiy shakl:
I've known him… (not I've been knowing)
tip: O'zbekcha "…dan beri + hozirgi zamon" (5 yildan beri ishlayman) inglizchaga have + 3-shakl yoki have been + -ing bilan tarjima qilinadi.
ex: I've lived in Tashkent for ten years.
How long have you known Lola?
She has been working here since 2020.
U 2020 yildan beri shu yerda ishlaydi.
We've been married for five years.
How long have you been waiting?
mi: I have known him for years.
How long have you been here?

title: for / since / ago
lesson:
for + davomiylik: for three years, for two hours
(… davomida / … dan beri)
since + boshlanish nuqtasi: since 2015, since Monday
(… dan beri)
ago = oldin: two years ago
(ikki yil oldin)

• I've lived here since 2015.
(2015 yildan beri shu yerda yashayman.)
• I met him two years ago.
(U bilan ikki yil oldin tanishganman.)

q.q: She has worked here ___ three years.
q.uz: U bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlaydi.
U bilan ikki yil oldin tanishganman.

q.q: I haven't seen her ___ last summer.

intro:
Bu mavzuda vaqtni ko'rsatuvchi uchta so'zni farqlashni o'rganamiz:
• for — qancha davomida: for 3 years (3 yildan beri / 3 yil davomida)
• since — qachondan beri (boshlanish nuqtasi): since 2015 (2015 yildan beri)
• ago — …oldin: 3 years ago (3 yil oldin)
explain:
1. for va since

Ikkalasi ham ko'pincha present perfect bilan keladi, lekin:
for + davomiyliksince + boshlanish nuqtasi
for two hourssince 8 o'clock
for five dayssince Monday
for ten yearssince 2015
for a long timesince I was a child
Qanday ajratish: "Qancha vaqt?" → for. "Qachondan beri?" → since.

2. ago

ago vaqtdan keyin keladi va past simple bilan ishlatiladi:
• I met him two years ago. (U bilan ikki yil oldin tanishganman.)
• She left ten minutes ago. (U o'n daqiqa oldin ketdi.)

3. Solishtiring

• I came here two years ago. (Bu yerga ikki yil oldin kelganman.) — past simple
• I've been here for two years. (Ikki yildan beri shu yerdaman.) — present perfect
tip: O'zbekchada "…dan beri" ham for, ham since bo'lishi mumkin. Tanlash uchun qarang: keyingi so'z muddat (3 yil) bo'lsa for, sana yoki payt (2015, dushanba) bo'lsa since.
ex: I've been here for two hours.
We've known each other since school.
They got married five years ago.
Ular besh yil oldin turmush qurishgan.
He has worked here for a long time.
U bu yerda uzoq vaqtdan beri ishlaydi.
mi: I met her ago two years.
I met her two years ago.
I have seen him two days ago.
I saw him two days ago.

title: I have done and I did
lesson:
have done — vaqt aytilmaydi, natija hozir muhim:
• I've lost my keys.
(Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim.)

did — aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, last week, in 2019, ago, when?):
• I lost my keys yesterday.
(Kecha kalitlarimni yo'qotdim.)

⚠️ When did you arrive? (not When have you arrived?)

q.q: I ___ my keys. I can't open the door.
q.uz: Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Eshikni ocha olmayapman.
Biz bir soat oldin kechki ovqat yedik.
q.w: an hour ago → past simple: had.

q.uz: Men bu yerda 2010 yildan beri yashayman.

intro:
Bu mavzuda present perfect (I have done) va past simple (I did) ni farqlashni o'rganamiz. Ikkalasi ham o'tmishdagi ish haqida, lekin:

• I have done — qachon bo'lgani aytilmaydi, natija hozir muhim.
• I did — aniq o'tgan vaqt aytiladi yoki tushuniladi (kecha, 2019 yilda, ikki kun oldin).
explain:
1. Asosiy farq

Present perfectPast simple
Vaqt aytilmaydiAniq vaqt bor
Natija hozir muhimIsh o'tmishda qolgan
I've lost my key.I lost my key yesterday.
ever, never, just, already, yet, for, sinceyesterday, last…, ago, in 2010, when…?

2. Belgi so'zlarga qarang

• yesterday / last week / in 2019 / two days ago bo'lsa → faqat past simple:
I saw him yesterday. (not I have seen him yesterday)
• When…? savoli → past simple:
When did you arrive? (not When have you arrived?)

3. Suhbatda ketma-ketlik

Avval yangilik present perfect bilan, keyin tafsilotlar past simple bilan aytiladi:
• I've broken my phone! — Oh no! How did it happen? — I dropped it.
(Telefonimni sindirib qo'ydim! — Voy! Qanday bo'ldi? — Tushirib yubordim.)
tip: O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham ko'pincha bir xil tarjima qilinadi ("yo'qotdim"). Shuning uchun gapda vaqt so'zi bormi-yo'qligiga qarang: bor bo'lsa past simple, yo'q bo'lsa va natija hozir muhim bo'lsa present perfect.
ex: I lost my wallet last week.
Have you ever been to Khiva? — Yes, I went there in 2021.
Hech Xivada bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, 2021 yilda borganman.
U 2018 yildan beri shu yerda ishlaydi.
U 2010 yildan 2015 yilgacha shu yerda ishlagan.
mi: Did you ever go to Bukhara?
Have you ever been to Bukhara?

title: is done / was done (passive 1)
lesson:
is/are + past participle · was/were + past participle
Ishni kim qilgani muhim emas, nima qilingani muhim.

• English is spoken in many countries.
(Ingliz tilida ko'p mamlakatlarda gapiriladi.)
• This house was built in 1990.
(Bu uy 1990 yilda qurilgan.)
• The windows are cleaned every week.
(Derazalar har hafta tozalanadi.)

Kim qilganini aytish uchun by: The book was written by Navoi.

q.w: Ingliz tilida (kimdir) gapiradi → passive: is spoken.
Uy qurilgan (kim qurgani muhim emas) → was built.

q.q: The film was directed ___ a famous director.
q.uz: Film mashhur rejissyor tomonidan suratga olingan.

intro:
Passive — majhul nisbat. Biz uni ishni kim qilgani muhim bo'lmaganda yoki noma'lum bo'lganda ishlatamiz. Asosiy e'tibor nima qilinganiga qaratiladi.

O'zbek tilida bunga "-il / -in" qo'shimchasi to'g'ri keladi: qurilgan, gapiriladi, tozalanadi.
This house was built in 1990. (Bu uy 1990 yilda qurilgan.)
explain:
1. Shakli

be + fe'lning 3-shakli
ZamonShaklMisol
Present simpleam / is / are + 3-shaklEnglish is spoken here.
Past simplewas / were + 3-shaklThe bridge was built in 1980.

2. Faol va majhul gapni solishtiring

• Faol: Somebody cleans the room every day. (Kimdir xonani har kuni tozalaydi.)
• Majhul: The room is cleaned every day. (Xona har kuni tozalanadi.)
Kim tozalashi muhim emas, shuning uchun majhul nisbat qulay.

3. Kim qilganini aytish: by

• This book was written by Abdulla Qodiriy. (Bu kitobni Abdulla Qodiriy yozgan.)
• The telephone was invented by Bell.

4. Savol va inkor

• Was the letter sent? (Xat yuborildimi?)
• The rooms aren't cleaned on Sundays. (Yakshanba kunlari xonalar tozalanmaydi.)
tip: O'zbekchadagi -il / -in qo'shimchasi (yasaldi, sotiladi, yozilgan) ko'pincha passive ga to'g'ri keladi. Inglizchada uni be + 3-shakl bilan yasaymiz.
ex: These shoes are made in Italy.
The windows are cleaned every month.
mi: The book was written from Navoi.
The book was written by Navoi.

title: is being done / has been done (passive 2)
lesson:
is/are being + past participle — hozir qilinyapti
has/have been + past participle — qilib bo'lingan

• The road is being repaired.
(Yo'l ta'mirlanyapti.)
• My car has been stolen!
(Mashinam o'g'irlab ketilibdi!)
• The rooms have been cleaned.
(Xonalar tozalab bo'lindi.)

q.q: My car ___ ! I can't find it. (steal)
q.w: Natija hozir (mashina yo'q) → has been stolen.

q.q: The rooms ___ . They look nice now. (clean)
q.w: Xonalar — ko'plik, natija bor → have been cleaned.

q.q: A new hotel ___ near the station now.
q.uz: Hozir vokzal yonida yangi mehmonxona qurilyapti.

q.q: All the tickets ___ . There are none left.
q.uz: Barcha chiptalar sotib bo'lingan. Birortasi qolmadi.
q.w: Natija: hech biri qolmagan → have been sold.

intro:
Bu mavzuda passive (majhul nisbat) ning yana ikki shaklini o'rganamiz:
• is being done — hozir qilinyapti: The road is being repaired. (Yo'l ta'mirlanyapti.)
• has been done — qilib bo'lingan, natija hozir bor: My car has been stolen! (Mashinam o'g'irlab ketilibdi!)
explain:
1. Shakllar

ZamonShaklMisol
Present continuousam/is/are being + 3-shaklThe house is being painted.
Present perfecthave/has been + 3-shaklThe room has been cleaned.

2. Faol va majhul

• They are building a new school. → A new school is being built.
(Yangi maktab qurilyapti.)
• Someone has taken my pen. → My pen has been taken.
(Ruchkamni olib ketishibdi.)

3. being va been farqi

• being — jarayon, hozir davom etyapti (is being repaired)
• been — tugallangan, natija bor (has been repaired)
Ikkalasida ham asosiy fe'l 3-shaklda bo'ladi.

4. Inkor va savol

• The letter hasn't been sent yet. (Xat hali yuborilmadi.)
• Has the work been finished? (Ish tugatildimi?)
tip: O'zbekchada: "ta'mirlanyapti" (-yap + -n) = is being repaired; "o'g'irlanibdi / o'g'irlab ketilibdi" = has been stolen.
ex: Our flat is being painted this week.
All the tickets have been sold.
The results have been sent to the teacher.
A new metro line is being built in Tashkent.

title: be / have / do in present and past tenses
lesson:
be + -ing (continuous) · be + past participle (passive)
have + past participle (perfect)
do / does / did — simple zamonda savol va inkor

• Are you working? · Was the car repaired?
• Have you finished? · Has she gone?
• Do you like it? · Did you see it?
(Yoqadimi? · Ko'rdingizmi?)

q.q: What ___ you doing at 8 o'clock last night?
q.uz: Kecha soat 8 da nima qilayotgan edingiz?

intro:
Bu mavzu — takrorlash. Ingliz tilida uchta yordamchi fe'l bor: be, have, do. Qaysi zamonda qaysi biri kerakligini bilish juda muhim, chunki savol va inkor shular yordamida yasaladi.

• be (am/is/are/was/were) → -ing va passive bilan
• have (have/has) → 3-shakl bilan (present perfect)
• do (do/does/did) → oddiy zamonlarda savol va inkor uchun
explain:
1. Qaysi yordamchi fe'l?

ZamonYordamchiSavolInkor
Present continuousam/is/areAre you working?I'm not working.
Past continuouswas/wereWere you sleeping?I wasn't sleeping.
PassivebeWas it made in Japan?It isn't made here.
Present perfecthave/hasHave you finished?I haven't finished.
Present simpledo/doesDo you like it?I don't like it.
Past simpledidDid you see it?I didn't see it.

2. Qanday aniqlash

Asosiy fe'lga qarang:
• fe'l -ing bilan → be: Are you going?
• fe'l 3-shaklda (done, seen, gone) → have yoki passive bo'lsa be
• fe'l oddiy shaklda (go, like, see) → do / does / did
tip: O'zbek tilida bunday yordamchi fe'llar yo'q, savol "-mi" bilan, inkor "-ma" bilan yasaladi. Shuning uchun inglizchada avval asosiy fe'l shakliga qarab, kerakli yordamchi fe'lni tanlashni odat qiling.
ex: She doesn't eat meat, but she isn't a vegetarian.
U go'sht yemaydi, lekin vegetarian emas.
mi: Have you finished? / Did you finish?

title: regular and irregular verbs
lesson:
Regular: past = past participle = -ed
work → worked → worked · stop → stopped → stopped

Irregular: o'zgacha shakllar, yodlash kerak
go → went → gone · see → saw → seen
take → took → taken · write → wrote → written
break → broke → broken · speak → spoke → spoken
buy → bought → bought · make → made → made

• I saw Ali yesterday.
(Kecha Alini ko'rdim.)
• I have seen this film.
(Bu filmni ko'rganman.)

q.w: take — took — taken; past simple → took.

q.q: She ___ a letter to her friend yesterday.

intro:
Ingliz tilida fe'llar ikki turga bo'linadi: to'g'ri (regular) va noto'g'ri (irregular).

• To'g'ri fe'llar o'tgan zamonda va 3-shaklda shunchaki -ed oladi: work → worked → worked.
• Noto'g'ri fe'llar o'zgacha o'zgaradi va ularni yodlash kerak: go → went → gone.

Har bir fe'lning 3 ta shakli bor: 1-shakl (asosiy), 2-shakl (past simple), 3-shakl (present perfect va passive uchun).
explain:
1. Qaysi shakl qayerda ishlatiladi

ShaklQayerdaMisol
1 (go)present simple, will, can, did/didn't dan keyinI go. Did you go?
2 (went)past simple (+)I went home.
3 (gone)have/has + 3, passiveHe has gone.

2. Eng kerakli noto'g'ri fe'llar

gowentgone

writewrotewritten
speakspokespoken
breakbrokebroken
eatateeaten
givegavegiven
